# apipbx_firewall_site (Resource)

A connection on a dynamic address (an office or home whose ISP renumbers it), kept as a DNS name that follows it. Its current addresses are let through every restricted service of the firewall (or only the listed ones), and the ruleset is rewritten when the name's address changes (checked every minute; a lookup that fails keeps the last address). Import with the site id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The DNS name (dynamic DNS, or any name kept pointing at the connection).
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `services` (Set of String) ssh, api, https, sip, sips, wss, iax2 or rtp; empty is every restricted service.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Set of String) What the name resolves to now.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
